title: Pack in the kb_mcp tests with the kb copy line off, and prove it in a behind clone
goal: Every test in test_kb_mcp.py that asserts kb_pack text runs the server with KB_NO_UPSTREAM=1 through one helper, the behind-clone tests clear it, and test_kb_mcp_pack_ignores_freshness_banner plants a clone 3 commits behind its origin/main: the helper's pack opens with coverage:, the same pack without it with the kb copy line
